scope: Source-linked oncology history, imaging and pathology summaries, and directly reported quantitative observations.

date_conventions.partial_dates: YYYY-MM means month precision; null means not established.
date_conventions.source_dates: Document/report dates are separate from specimen collection or treatment dates.
date_conventions.patient_reported_dates: Patient reports are explicitly labeled and are not confirmation of administration.

evidence_labels.documented: Supported directly by the relevant primary report.
evidence_labels.clinician_reported_delivered: Delivery is recorded in a clinical note; original administration records were not reviewed.
evidence_labels.clinician_reported_completed: Procedure/admission is recorded in a clinical note; original procedural records were not reviewed.
evidence_labels.clinician_reported_result: Result is summarized in a clinical note; the original report was not reviewed.
evidence_labels.patient_reported_administered: Patient reports administration; original records were not reviewed.
evidence_labels.patient_reported_completed: Patient reports completion; original records were not reviewed.
evidence_labels.patient_reported_result: Patient reports a result; original report was not reviewed.
evidence_labels.patient_reported_plan: Intended treatment; actual administration is not established.
evidence_labels.measured_result_in_authenticated_portal_: An explicit measured value displayed in a privately preserved authenticated result-page capture.
evidence_labels.measured_result_in_primary_patient_porta: A measured value printed in a privately preserved native portal trend export.
evidence_labels.clinician_reported_treatment_hold: Treatment hold recorded in a clinical note; original administration records were not reviewed.
evidence_labels.clinician_reported_plan: Clinician-documented plan; actual administration is not established.
evidence_labels.primary_amended_report: Directly reported result in the reviewed amended primary assay report.
evidence_labels.documented_primary_slide_review: Directly reported institutional review of a stated subset of previously collected slides.

important_limits: Coverage is selective and is not a complete medical record.
No independent radiology re-read, RECIST adjudication or causal treatment-effect analysis was performed.
Pathology MMR immunohistochemistry is reported as measured; it does not substitute for a separate molecular microsatellite assay.
Source metadata describes privately reviewed records; a source ID does not imply the original document is downloadable.

The ctDNA table contains 12 dated draws transcribed from the 23 June 2026 Signatera report and a separately labelled patient-reported value of 100 MTM/mL with no documented draw date. CEA, blood counts and chemistry records remain incomplete.
Prepared native image series are available for the 8 April 2026 PET-CT; later image datasets remain missing.
Laboratory observations include authenticated portal captures and twelve CEA trend-export observations; coverage remains incomplete.
Collection and result issue times are separate. Missing metadata remains null; final status and institution are not assumed.
CEA, CEA (LabDAQ) and City of Hope assays retain distinct source/method series. Values are not assumed interchangeable.
Some CBC unit strings contain a captured encoding artifact; original representations are retained.
Patient-reported ctDNA remains distinct from primary-report ctDNA observations.
Sources describe the exact privately reviewed representation; a complete portal note/report capture is distinct from a downloaded original PDF or DICOM study.
A separately prepared selected-series April 8, 2026 PET/CT release exists; new report review does not establish availability of any additional DICOM studies.
The Personalis amended PPM measurement is separate from the Signatera MTM/mL table; the superseded collection date is not a second result.
Low or zero plasma tumor fractions and negative report findings do not establish current tissue RAS/RAF status, absence of cancer or treatment response.
Institutional slide-review node counts describe the reviewed subset; they do not replace the original resection node count.

source_document_scope: Selected prepared report copies; original source files are not published.

laboratory_field_conventions.value: Numeric quantity; preserve printed precision, comparator and original units in companion fields.
laboratory_field_conventions.value_as_reported: Original value display. Capture-derived rows include the unit; trend-derived rows may store the numeric token only.
laboratory_field_conventions.comparator: Explicit <, >, <= or >= only. A threshold observation must not be plotted as an exact value.
laboratory_field_conventions.series_id: Distinct displayed component, resulting lab, institution and explicitly reported method; unknown fields remain unknown.
laboratory_field_conventions.collection_datetime: Explicit specimen collection local time, without an inferred timezone offset.
laboratory_field_conventions.report_datetime: Explicit result issue local time. Different issue times/source results are preserved.
laboratory_field_conventions.reference_range_as_reported: Displayed reference range text; no derived normal/abnormal judgement.
laboratory_field_conventions.flag_as_reported: Only the displayed flag; missing flag is not a derived normal result.

liquid_biopsy_field_conventions.observation_id: LQB identifiers belong to this separate assay/unit table.
liquid_biopsy_field_conventions.date: Corrected specimen collection date from the amended primary report.
liquid_biopsy_field_conventions.report_date: Report header/signature date; literal source discrepancies are retained in notes.
liquid_biopsy_field_conventions.unit: Original assay unit. PPM is not MTM/mL and has no conversion in this dataset.

plasma_profiling_field_conventions.assay_id: PLASMA-ASSAY identifiers label report-specific observations, not validated sequencing file assignments.
plasma_profiling_field_conventions.findings: Mixed categorical and numeric observations; retain comparator, unit, classification and interpretation_as_reported.
plasma_profiling_field_conventions.limitations: Display with the report findings, including low-fraction and file-linkage limits.

clinical_specimen_ids.CL-SP-006: Sampled GI biopsies and ascending-colon polyp collected April 16, 2026.

laboratory_date_range.basis: Recorded dates for available numeric observations, including imaging-preparation glucose; individual rows retain their date basis.

portal_laboratory_date_range.basis: Dated portal laboratory observations; this is selective coverage, not a complete longitudinal record.
